scope: Backstage source census only. No source in this file is admitted to a production adapter.
overlap_method: Frozen identifiers were checked by exact equality against the committed served artifacts and, for the City Record control, an exact request_id/PIN query. Agency-name, vendor-name, title, amount, and fuzzy identifier similarity were not counted as overlap.

existing_snapshot.interpretation: Counts are the committed CityScroll snapshot, not a claim that any source is a complete citywide inventory.
